# Daily Briefing – Friday 13 November

Yesterday was a quiet one — no recorded activity and 6,945 steps, though your body still burned 2,418 kcal, which is a good sign your metabolism is ticking along nicely. The main concern is sleep: 5.9 hours simply isn't enough to support your training and weight loss goals simultaneously.

That shorter sleep is almost certainly why your HRV sits at 85ms, below your 91-122ms baseline. The good news is your resting HR of 54 bpm and stress score of 38 both look solid, so you're not in a hole — just slightly underpowered. If today has a hard session planned, consider dialling intensity back by 10-15% rather than skipping it entirely.

Prioritise protein today — hit that 175g target deliberately across meals to protect muscle while you're in a calorie deficit. And tonight, aim for 7.5-8 hours; that's your real performance enhancer right now. 💪
